description: A minecraft mod that allows for producing resources out of portals that you create with help of endermen

mods.name: The Void Cult
mods.description:
A mod that allows you to run an ender cult capable of stealing materials from other dimensions.
Obtain §dPortal Matter§r by performing "teleport" activities or killing end mobs.
Build a §5Void Altar§r with a proper beacon-like base with the blocks it asks for and craft the §3Ender Cultist Helmet§r to gain enderman trust.
Recruit endermen with §eSin-Infused Fruit§r to get them to steal resources and even mobs from other dimensions, alternatively you can eat those yourself and experience some effects.
Use §eCult Leader Staff§r to re-assign cultists up to your liking.


There are 5 cultist types:

- §cWrath§r - Fearless but also a little sadistic, will have fun kidnapping mobs and trapping them into pearls to release whenever you want.

- §eGreed§r - Craving for treasures, loves their shine, will bring you all of the precious materials that can be mined underground.

- §6Gluttony§r - Always hungry for food but also for knowledge, will provide endless supplies of food but also aid you in enchanting.

- §dPride§r - Views itself above nature and to reflect it, they will bring you stolen plants to prove it.

- §aEnvy§r - Jealous that the end dimension is so barren, will gladly steal building blocks from other dimensions to have a better looking base.

- §9Sloth§r - Lazy enough to steal only already prepared loot, may bring you structure loot, or may bring you empty chests and not even care.



You can customize the balance of the mod by either changing config, or creating a datapack that will overwrite the default loot tables and recipes.
No promises that it will be balanced out of the box for whatever you're making.

releases.notes:
Balance changes:

- Nerfed default portal matter drop rate from endermites [0.75 -> 0.5].
- Fixed tier 2 greed ritual producing 4x more gold and 8x more diamonds/emeralds than intended.
- Reduced tier 3 greed ritual weight for junk drops (overall it's a buff to rare material drop rates).

releases.notes:
New features:
- Added an optional datapack that sets the world spawn in the outer end and provides you with a starting island with everything necessary to progress through the mod, the early game will also serve as a small puzzle to to not softlock yourself like it is the case with standard skyblock. You can enable this datapack upon world creation or by using the /datapack command.

Bug fixes:
- Fixed manual rituals (when using portal matter on an altar) having 1/7 chance to drop nothing.
- Fixed being able to perform manual rituals on tier 0 / disrupted altars.

releases.notes:
New features:

- New cultist - sloth - this one will generate structure loot for you, ranging from shipwreck junk to end city loot at higher tiers, might also produce an elytra, however they have a very high failure rate and will often produce empty chests.

- New sin fruit corresponding to the new cultist with effects that will help you "hide from your problems".

- New portal matter function - It can be used on the void altar to manually steal items from other dimensions at the expense of 1 portal matter. Loot will be random and taken from a random loot table for the corresponding altar tier. This mechanic is also compatible with dispensers.

Balances: 

- Wrath cultists now have their "junk" loot replaced ("Air" -> "Mob pearl - Endermite"), making them the best option for portal matter grinding

- To compensate for the wrath cultist buff, reduced the default amount of portal matter dropped by endermites (2 -> 0.75), otherwise it would be a little too strong.

Misc changes:

- Swapped colors of envy and pride to fit the already existing convention of "deadly sin colors" (yes, this is a real thing).

- Clicking on cultists with a sin fruit won't trigger an eating process anymore.

- Altars now generate a small burst of particles on a successful ritual.

releases.notes:
First release of the mod.

A mod that allows you to run an ender cult capable of stealing materials from other dimensions.
Obtain **Portal Matter** by performing "teleport" activities or killing end mobs.
Build a **Void Altar** with a proper beacon-like base with the blocks it asks for and craft the **Ender Cultist Helmet** to gain enderman trust.
Recruit endermen with Sin-Infused Fruit to get them to steal resources and even mobs from other dimensions.
Use **Cult Leader Staff** to re-assign cultists up to your liking.

There are 5 cultist types:
- Wrath - Fearless but also a little sadistic, will have fun kidnapping mobs and trapping them into pearls to release whenever you want.
- Greed - Craving for treasures, loves their shine, will bring you all of the precious materials that can be mined underground.
- Gluttony - Always hungry for food but also for knowledge, will provide endless supplies of food but also aid you in enchanting.
- Pride - Views itself above nature and to reflect it, they will bring you stolen plants to prove it.
- Envy - Jealous that the end dimension is so barren, will gladly steal building blocks from other dimensions to have a better looking base.


You can customize the balance of the mod by either changing config, or creating a datapack that will overwrite the default loot tables and recipes.
No promises that it will be balanced out of the box for whatever you're making.

The mod will allow you to produce materials ex nihilo, but also obtain everything while being permanently stuck in the end dimension... for some reason.
